jobPostingInfo.title: Tootmistöötaja
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Production Supervisor


 

Sinu roll ja vastutus: 

Selles rollis töötad montöörina ABB sagedusmuundurite tehases Jüris. 


Sinu töö on tähendusrikas ja olulise mõjuga. ABB tooted aitavad ettevõtetel vähendada energiakulu ja tõsta tootmisprotsessi efektiivsust. Enamik toodetest läheb ekspordiks erinevatesse riikidesse üle maailma. Sa lood lisaväärtust läbi kliendinõuetele vastavate toodete õigeaegse ja kvaliteetse montaaži.  


Väljaõpe kohapeal:

Sa ei pea kõike kohe oskama. Pakume praktilist väljaõpet meie kogenud montööride juhendamisel.


Tasuta transport. Tööle toob ja koju viib ABB tasuta transport. Bussid sõidavad kuuel liinil - Maardu, Lasnamäe, Õismäe, Mustamäe, Kesklinn, Kopli 


Sinu peamised vastutusvaldkonnad:

  • Kvaliteetne ja õigeaegne toodete montaaž vastavalt tehnilistele joonistele ja juhenditele  
  • Tootmisprotsessi jälgimine ja dokumentatsiooni korrashoid 
  • Tööohutuse ja töötervishoiu nõuete järgimine
  • Ettepanekute tegemine tootmise, ohutuse ja töökeskkonna parandamiseks
  • Kolleegide toetamine

Sinult ootame:

  • Elektriskeemide ja jooniste lugemise oskust
  • Tehnilist mõtlemist ja täpsust
  • Kesk- või kutseharidust tehnilises valdkonnas
  • Varasem kogemus sarnasel ametikohal tuleb kasuks
  • Töö toimub vahetustes esmaspäevast reedeni. Kaheksatunnised vahetused vahelduvad nädalati: hommikune kell 6:30–14:30 ja õhtune 14:30–22:30

Sulle lubame:

Me hoolime. Sinu tervis ja enesetunne on meile olulised. Pakume tervisekindlustust, sporditoetust ja muid hüvesid, mis aitavad sul hoida tasakaalu töö ja elu vahel.

Teeme koostööd. Uute töötajate sisse elamist toetatakse ja Sa ei jää üksi. Töötad meeskonnas, kus üksteist alati abistatakse.

Panustame Sinu karjääri arengusse. Sul on võimalus enda oskuseid igapäevaselt arendada ning kasvada ABB karjäärivõimaluste kaudu.

Väärtustame Sinu panust. Sinu töö loeb. Pakume stabiilset sissetulekut, lisatasu ning märkame tehtud tööd.

Hoiame asjad lihtsad ja toimivad. ABB töövahendid, protsessid ja alati puhas töökeskkond on korraldatud nii, et saaksid keskenduda oma tööle ilma liigse keerukuseta.

jobPostingInfo.title: Lead Telecom Engineer (2 Years Contract)
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Automation Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be a design authority for an engineering discipline. Each day, you will complete assignments on multiple projects of moderate size or portions of major projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring assignments are completed in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards.

The work model for the role is: Onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:


  • Serving as the single point of technical authority for all telecommunications-related systems.
  • Performing Basic and Detailed Engineering activities, delivering optimized end-to-end telecom solutions for offshore FPSO and platform projects.
  • Leading and mentoring a team of telecom engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring effective execution of project deliverables.
  • Coordinating telecom engineering activities with multidisciplinary teams, including ICSS, Electrical, Instrumentation, Marine disciplines, as well as telecom package and equipment suppliers.
  • Planning, coordinating and monitoring engineering activities to ensure compliance with project schedules, quality standards, and established procedures.
  • Providing technical leadership by resolving critical engineering and quality issues, offering guidance to the engineering team, and facilitating cross-discipline collaboration.
  • Interfacing with customers, project managers, and key stakeholders on technical matters, including participation in project kick-off meetings, progress reviews, and design workshops.



Qualifications for the role


  • Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline, with proven experience in telecommunications engineering for offshore FPSO, platform, oil & gas, marine, or EPC projects.
  • Strong technical knowledge of offshore telecom system design, engineering, integration, testing, and commissioning across the full project lifecycle, including FEED, Detailed Design, procurement support, and execution phases.
  • Hands-on experience with Public Address & General Alarm (PAGA) systems, including integration with ICSS, ESD, Fire & Gas, and other safety-critical systems.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Telephony and Data Communication Networks, including IP Telephony, PABX, LAN/WAN infrastructure, cybersecurity, network segregation, routing protocols (OSPF, EIGRP, Static and Default Routing), VLANs, network redundancy, and security configurations.
  • In-depth knowledge of Radio Communication Systems, including VHF/UHF, TETRA, Point-to-Multipoint Radio, Microwave Transmission Systems, and other wireless communication technologies used in offshore environments.
  • Experience in the design and integration of Security and Surveillance Systems, including CCTV, Video Management Systems (VMS), Access Control Systems, Intrusion Detection Systems, Perimeter Protection Systems, Personnel Tracking, and Muster Systems.
  • Familiarity with Marine Communication and Navigation Systems, as well as interface management and integration requirements between telecom, marine, and operational systems.
  • Strong expertise in Fiber Optic and Satellite Communication Systems, including SDH, DWDM, optical transmission networks, fiber optic backbone infrastructure, structured and OSP cabling systems, VSAT, satellite communications, and SCADA telemetry solutions where applicable.



More about us


The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in
their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence
(AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.


Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobPostingInfo.title: Analista de Engenharia de Projetos Pleno
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Engineering Manager

__

Missão da posição  

Você gosta de engenharia elétrica e de automação, de trabalhar com software e controladores industriais e quer atuar em projetos para a América do Sul?  

Na ABB, buscamos um(a) Analista de Engenharia de Projetos Pleno para atuar na área de Automação, na divisão de Process Industries (AUPI). A posição atende projetos de sistemas de retificadores de alta potência (HPR) no mercado da América do Sul.  

Você vai apoiar as atividades de engenharia dos projetos, do projeto ao comissionamento. Isso inclui o desenvolvimento de soluções com controladores industriais e sistemas de comunicação.  

 

Responsabilidades 

  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento da engenharia dos projetos, coletando dados, fazendo cálculos e análises e elaborando a documentação técnica sob sua responsabilidade. 
  • Desenvolver e configurar soluções de automação com controladores industriais (programação de CLP) aplicadas a sistemas de retificadores de alta potência (HPR). 
  • Desenvolver projetos elétricos (definição de hardware, esquemas elétricos, desenhos eletromecânicos etc.) para retificadores de alta potência (HPR) 
  • Garantir que a lista de materiais (BOM) atenda às obrigações do contrato e que as entregas sigam os prazos, a qualidade e os custos planejados. 
  • Acompanhar o plano de trabalho, escopo, cronograma e as estimativas de custo definidos pelo gerente do projeto, trabalhando com ele do recebimento do pedido até o encerramento. 
  • Trabalhar com as áreas de Suprimentos, Manufatura e Testes para que as soluções sejam fabricadas, montadas e testadas conforme o projeto, e atualizar os documentos de engenharia como construído (as-built). 
  • Participar de Testes de Aceitação em Fábrica (FAT) de projetos de retificadores de alta potência. 
  • Prestar suporte, tanto remotamente quanto no local, a clientes que utilizam sistemas de retificadores. 
  • Trabalhar com as áreas de Comissionamento e Serviços para que os projetos sejam instalados e comissionados corretamente, e atualizar os documentos após a instalação. 
  • Apoiar clientes e contatos técnicos em questões de engenharia e participar de reuniões e workshops, em português, inglês e espanhol, com times da região e globais. 
  • Apoiar a avaliação de riscos técnicos, reportar problemas de qualidade, segurança, cibersegurança, contrato e custo, e sugerir melhorias em processos e ferramentas.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica ou Controle e Automação.
  • Experiência em elétrica e automação, com atuação em software.
  • Experiência com programação de CLPs, parametrização e comunicação de redes industriais.
  • Conhecimento de esquemas elétricos e de controle.
  • Interesse em atuar com sistemas de potência (HPR).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pelo Brasil e pela América do Sul

Diferenciais

  • Inglês ou espanhol avançado, para interagir com times da região e globais.
  • Conhecimento em acionamentos e inversores de frequência.
  • Experiência em projetos de engenharia para indústrias de processo.
  • Experiência em comissionamento, testes ou startup de sistemas de automação.
  • Experiências em Softwares Autocad, Eplan ou E3
  • Pensamento colaborativo para trabalho em equipe, postura proativa, senso de urgência e forte orientação para resultados.

O que oferecemos

  • Atuação em projetos de automação e sistemas de potência para indústrias de processo.
  • Contato com times de engenharia da região e globais.
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com aprendizado contínuo e acesso a tecnologias avançadas.
  • Desenvolvimento profissional em uma empresa global de tecnologia, com possibilidade de crescimento na carreira técnica.
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido, com 2 dias presenciais em Sorocaba ou São Paulo.

Sobre a divisão de Process Industries (AUPI) da ABB

A divisão de Process Industries (AUPI) faz parte da área de negócios de Automação da ABB. Ela atende indústrias de processo, como mineração, metais, óleo e gás, química e papel e celulose, com soluções de automação, eletrificação, digitalização e serviços. A ABB ajuda esses clientes a operar de forma mais segura, confiável, eficiente e sustentável.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Job Description:

About Us

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

 

Global Business Services

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

 

Process Overview

Our Global Banking & Markets division serves mid- to large-sized corporations and institutional clients worldwide. It is comprised of Business Banking, Global Commercial Banking, Global Corporate & Investment Banking, Global Markets and Wholesale Credit. Aligned with these client-facing groups are Global Capital Markets and Global Research. TWO is the process initiative aiming at enhancing the synergy between users and technology.  Connects have been happening across users to ideate, develop and implement the ideas from ML, productivity enhancements.

 

Job Description: -

Responsible for developing and delivering software requirements to accomplish business goals. Ensures that software is developed to meet functional, non-functional, and compliance requirements. Codes solutions, unit tests, and ensures the solution can be integrated successfully into the overall application/system with clear, robust and well-tested interfaces. Familiar with development and testing practices of the bank. Contributes to story refinement/defining requirements. Participates and guides team in estimating work necessary to realize a story/requirement through the delivery lifecycle. Performs spike/proof of concept as necessary to mitigate risk or implement new ideas. Codes solutions and unit tests to deliver a requirement/story per the defined acceptance criteria and compliance requirements Utilizes multiple architectural components (across data, application, business) in design and development of client requirements. Assists team with resolving technical complexities involved in realizing story work. Helps in fine tuning the system from performance standpoint and manages system administration functions. Helps in efficient running of lower environment and production environment including contributing to upgrades. Contributes to existing test suites (integration, regression, performance); Analyzes test reports, identifies any test issues/errors; Triages the underlying cause. Documents and communicates required information for deployment, maintenance, support, and business functionality. Participates, contributes and can coach team members in the delivery/release (CI-CD) events. e.g. branching timelines, pull requests, issue triage, merge/conflict resolution, release notes

 

Responsibilities

jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Columbia Sportswear Company connects active people with their passions and is a global multi-brand leader in outdoor, active, and lifestyle products, including apparel, footwear, accessories, and equipment. Founded in 1938 in Portland, Oregon, the company's brands are sold in 122 countries. Alongside its flagship Columbia brand, the company owns Mountain Hardwear, SOREL, and prAna — together spanning hiking, trail running, snow sports, fishing, hunting, mountaineering, yoga, climbing, and everyday outdoor lifestyle apparel and footwear. With a strong global presence across wholesale, direct-to-consumer, and e-commerce channels, Columbia Sportswear Company India Sourcing Pvt Ltd plays a key role in supporting the organization's sourcing and supply chain operations worldwide.


Senior Power Platform & AI Engineer


We believe our people are our greatest asset and it is our goal to ignite the human potential for growth. We want you to grow and develop with us and recognize every career adventure is different, so we encourage you to build your own path

 

OUTGROWN YOUR OWN BACKYARD? COME PLAY IN OURS.


At Columbia, we’re as passionate about the outdoors as you are. And while our gear is available worldwide, we’re proud to be based in the Pacific Northwest, where natural wonders are our playground.  

Every product we make and every task we undertake is inspired by the famous words of our founder Gert Boyle: “It’s perfect. Now make it better.” As pioneers of relentless improvement, we are constantly evolving. 

We believe the outdoors is ours to protect and strive to keep our planet healthy. We believe in empowering people to experience the outdoors to the fullest.  

And we believe in you.  

 

ABOUT THE POSITION 


Although we're an apparel and footwear focused company, technology is central to everything we do.  Columbia Sportswear’s Intelligent Process Automation team enables business teams to increase efficiency and effectiveness while accelerating growth through engagement in high-value activities & innovation.

We are seeking a Senior Power Platform & AI Engineer with 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and delivering enterprise automation, AI, and low-code solutions. This role will primarily focus on Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and Generative AI, while also leveraging RPA and orchestration technologies to automate end-to-end business processes across enterprise systems.

The ideal candidate will be a technical leader capable of building intelligent copilots, agentic AI solutions, workflow automation, and scalable integrations that drive operational efficiency and business transformation.

 


HOW YOU’LL MAKE A DIFFERENCE 


AI Agent Development:

  • Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
  • Build conversational AI experiences that integrate with enterprise applications, knowledge sources, and business processes.
  • Implement prompt engineering, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and response validation strategies.
  • Optimize AI performance, accuracy, security, and user adoption.

Power Platform Development

  • Develop scalable solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Power Fx.
  • Build complex automation workflows and AI-powered business processes.
  • Create reusable components, custom connectors, and integration frameworks.
  • Lead solution design and technical implementation across the Power Platform ecosystem.

RPA & Intelligent Orchestration

  • Design and support enterprise automation solutions using RPA and orchestration platforms such as Microsoft Power Automate Desktop, Automation Anywhere, UiPath, or similar technologies.
  • Orchestrate end-to-end business processes across multiple systems, applications, and AI services.
  • Integrate attended and unattended automations with Copilot Studio agents and Power Platform solutions.
  • Drive intelligent automation initiatives by combining workflow automation, RPA, AI, and business rules.

Enterprise Integration & Architecture

  • Design end-to-end solutions integrating Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure services, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and third-party systems.
  • Develop API-based integrations using REST, JSON, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and custom connectors.
  • Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for scalability, reliability, security, and compliance.

Generative AI Engineering

  • Integrate Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Document Intelligence, and other AI services into business applications.
  • Implement responsible AI practices, content safety controls, governance frameworks, and hallucination mitigation techniques.
  • Monitor AI solution performance, usage, quality, and operational costs.

Technical Leadership

  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI-enabled solutions.
  • Mentor developers and provide technical leadership on Power Platform, AI, and automation best practices.
  • Drive adoption of emerging Microsoft AI capabilities, agentic AI patterns, and intelligent automation technologies.

YOU ARE 


  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform.
  • Advanced expertise in:
    • Microsoft Copilot Studio
    • Power Apps
    • Power Automate
    • Dataverse
    • Power Fx
  • Proven experience building enterprise copilots, conversational AI solutions, and agent-based applications.
  • Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, grounding, RAG, and Responsible AI practices.
  • Experience with:
    • REST APIs
    • JSON
    • Microsoft Graph
    • Custom Connectors
    • Enterprise System Integrations
  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:
    • Azure OpenAI
    • Azure AI Foundry
    • Azure Functions
    • Logic Apps
    • Azure AI Search
  • Experience designing secure, scalable, and supportable enterprise solutions.
  • Strong communication, architecture, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with RPA and orchestration platforms such as, Automation Anywhere, Power Automate Desktop or similar technologies.
  • Experience integrating AI agents with enterprise automation platforms.
  • Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, or RPA-related certifications.
  • Experience with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Purview, and enterprise governance frameworks.
  • Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, ALM, and agile delivery methodologies.

Job Description & Summary

About the role:

As a Regulatory Training Advisor within the XLoS Regulatory Reporting team, you will serve as a key escalation point and subject matter expert for regulatory and mandatory training matters, providing expert advice and guidance on complex training‑related queries, including exceptions and breaches. Your role will focus on thorough investigation, sound judgement, and recommending effective solutions, shifting from general execution to strategic advisory. You will proactively validate data to prevent issues, provide expert guidance on Audit Risk and Quality (ARQ) matters, and act as a trusted partner driving quality and compliance through enhanced tutor sourcing and delivery. This is a high-impact role demanding resilience, strong relationship management, and influencing skills to advise the business effectively.

What your days will look like:

  • Case Management & Investigation: Act as the primary escalation handler for training breaches, exceptions, and anomalies, conducting detailed root cause analysis and recommending corrective actions. Monitor and report trends to the Training Manager to support stakeholder discussions and QMSE reporting.
  • Compliance & Advisory Expertise: Maintain expert knowledge of ARQ requirements and XLoS mandatory training programmes to provide accurate, specialist guidance on compliance and regulatory reporting, ensuring consistent adherence across business units.
  • Data Quality & Governance: Proactively validate training target audiences to prevent breaches, working closely with Reporting Officers to ensure governance standards, high data quality, and effective end-to-end compliance processes.
  • Collaboration & Continuous Improvement: Partner with Course Managers to stay current on curricula and requirements, while driving improvements in tutor sourcing, accreditation, and engagement. Support change initiatives through automation and maintain robust documentation to ensure audit readiness and knowledge continuity.

This role is for you if you:

  • Have exceptional investigative and analytical skills, using sound judgement to draw conclusions and recommend actions
  • Can quickly build or apply expertise in ARQ and regulatory training compliance
  • Are a subject matter expert in XLoS mandatory training or related processes
  • Excel at building relationships and influencing stakeholders through excellent interpersonal skills
  • Are resilient, adaptable, and comfortable managing complex workloads and changing priorities
  • Communicate clearly and effectively, with excellent attention to detail and a focus on data accuracy

What you’ll receive from us:

No matter where you may be in your career or personal life, our benefits are designed to add value and support, recognising and rewarding you fairly for your contributions. We offer a range of benefits including empowered flexibility and a working week split between office, home and client site; private medical cover and 24/7 access to a qualified virtual GP; six volunteering days a year and much more.
